children: News Corp disclosed continued activity under its US$1 billion repurchase program, having purchased about US$493.7 million to date and reporting US$321.7 million of purchases on Sep 23, 2026.
The 2025 Repurchase Program authorizes up to US$1 billion of Class A and Class B shares to be repurchased to enhance shareholder value.
As of the latest filings, the company has purchased approximately US$493,677,916 of Class A and B shares under the program.
On Sep 23, 2026 the company repurchased 12,297,388 shares for total consideration of US$321,665,881.84.
Daily ASX disclosures show prior-day purchases across classes: 5,721,438 Class A shares for US$169,421,296.14 and 25,757 Class B shares for US$812,818.80 on specified reports.
Repurchases are subject to market conditions; broker named is Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and transactions are in USD.
